appearance.language.label: Language
appearance.language.description: The language of the shell, its notices, the settings, the lock and login screens and the boot menu. Automatic: the session language (English if there's no translation).

appearance.colorMode.label: Mode
appearance.colorMode.description: Light or dark for the shell and the apps. From the wallpaper: light with a bright wallpaper, dark with a dark one; in between it keeps the current one. Boot and login stay dark.

appearance.scheme.label: Color scheme for every wallpaper
appearance.scheme.description: How the palette is built from the wallpaper; each wallpaper can have its own exception. Status colors don't change.

appearance.appColors.label: App colors
appearance.appColors.description: Each app brings its color, taken from its icon and harmonized with your wallpaper: the ring of the chosen window when switching windows, a dot under the active app in the bar, the backdrop of its icon in notices and the launcher. Only in details; a grey icon uses the usual color.

appearance.contrast.label: Contrast
appearance.contrast.description: 0 = Material standard; more contrast separates text and backgrounds more (status colors too).

appearance.transparency.label: Panel transparency
appearance.transparency.description: Never drops below what stays readable over the wallpaper.

when.reason: High contrast makes the panels opaque.

appearance.font.ui.label: Interface font
appearance.font.ui.description: For the whole shell, the lock screen and the login screen.

appearance.avatar.label: Avatar
appearance.avatar.description: On the lock screen, the login screen and at boot. Cut from the wallpaper: cropped from the wallpaper at every theme change.

appearance.avatarImage.label: Avatar image
appearance.avatarImage.description: Used with “Own image”; cropped to the center.

accessibility.uiScale.label: Interface scale
accessibility.uiScale.description: From 85 % to 150 %. Everything grows together: text, icons, the bar, rows, spacing and panels. Only the shell; for apps, Displays → Scale.

accessibility.textScale.label: Text size
accessibility.textScale.description: From 85 % to 150 %, only the text, on top of the interface scale (for example, everything at 125 % and the text a bit more).

accessibility.focusRing.label: Always-visible focus
accessibility.focusRing.description: A ring around whatever has the keyboard focus.

accessibility.highContrast.label: High contrast
accessibility.highContrast.description: Secondary text and borders with the contrast of the main ones; opaque panels.

accessibility.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
accessibility.reduceMotion.description: No animations or transitions anywhere in the shell or the windows.

lock.glance.weather.label: Weather
lock.glance.weather.description: Temperature and sky, without the location. Hidden if the data is more than 2 hours old.

lock.glance.media.label: Music
lock.glance.media.description: When something plays: the title and the artist (or the player); never the cover. Visible even while the session is locked.

lock.glance.battery.label: Battery
lock.glance.battery.description: Only when running on battery, with the warning color at the low-battery thresholds.

lock.glance.notifications.label: Notices
lock.glance.notifications.description: How many notices arrived while locked, without their content. Hidden with Do not disturb on.

bar.layout.label: Bar layout
bar.layout.description: Drag the modules between left, center and right, in or out of a pill, or to Available to remove them.

bar.screens.label: Screens with a bar
bar.screens.description: Turn off the screens where you don't want it. With all of them on, it also goes on screens you connect later.

bar.activeWindow.maxWidth.label: Active window maximum width
bar.activeWindow.maxWidth.description: The title is cut with an ellipsis.

bar.notifications.count.label: Pending notices
bar.notifications.count.description: How the bell shows there are notices in the history.

bar.resources.warnPct.label: Resources: warn from
bar.resources.warnPct.description: Above it, the value shows in yellow.

bar.workspaces.perMonitor.label: Only this screen's
bar.workspaces.perMonitor.description: With several screens, each bar shows its own workspaces.

bar.workspaces.windowIcons.label: Window icons
bar.workspaces.windowIcons.description: Instead of circles, the icon of each window on the workspace.

bar.tooltips.label: Info on hover
bar.tooltips.description: A tooltip with each module's detail (the full date, the battery, the window…).

bar.scroll.label: The wheel over the bar
bar.scroll.description: Outside the workspaces (they have their own wheel).

system.sampleSeconds.label: Refresh the resources every
system.sampleSeconds.description: For the dashboard (System) and the bar's resources and network modules; only while visible.

bar.edge.label: Screen edge
bar.edge.description: On a side, the modules stack (the clock on two lines, icons only).

bar.size.label: Thickness
bar.size.description: Bar height (or width, if it's on a side).

bar.style.label: Style
bar.style.description: Floating: separate pills. Solid: a bar attached to the edge. Transparent: no backgrounds (over the wallpaper). Frame: the bar is the thick side of a frame around the screen, with rounded inner corners.

bar.frame.thickness.label: Frame thickness
bar.frame.thickness.description: Only with the Frame style: the three sides that aren't the bar.

bar.frame.radius.label: Frame corners
bar.frame.radius.description: Only with the Frame style: the radius of the inner corners.

bar.peek.label: Show only while holding Super
bar.peek.description: The bar takes no space and appears while you hold Super. For looking at it; to use it, keep it fixed (with Super, a click moves windows).

bar.peekMode.label: While holding Super
bar.peekMode.description: Over: it appears over what's open, with a background, moving nothing. Push: it reserves its space while visible and the windows make room.

when.reason: Only with “Show only while holding Super” on.

bar.peekDelay.label: Wait before showing it
bar.peekDelay.description: So quick Super shortcuts (Super+D, Super+A…) don't make it appear.

when.reason: Only with “Show only while holding Super” on.

bar.minWorkspaces.label: Workspaces always shown
bar.minWorkspaces.description: How many workspaces appear in the bar even when empty.

dashboard.weatherRefreshMinutes.label: Refresh the weather every
dashboard.weatherRefreshMinutes.description: Each query goes to Open-Meteo; a longer time means fewer requests.

capture.cardSeconds.label: Card duration
capture.cardSeconds.description: How long a capture's card stays on screen (it pauses with the pointer over it).

capture.recordingQuality.label: Recording quality
capture.recordingQuality.description: With hardware encoding: high = qp 20, balanced = qp 24, small = qp 28.

notifications.defaultSeconds.label: Notice duration
notifications.defaultSeconds.description: For notifications that don't set their own duration.

notifications.fullscreen.label: Notices in fullscreen and while sharing the screen
notifications.fullscreen.description: The ones not shown stay in the history and a summary appears when you leave. Battery notices always show.

system.maintenance.checkIntervalMinutes.label: Check the system every
system.maintenance.checkIntervalMinutes.description: Updates and system state; it's also checked after every pacman operation.

appearance.windows.rounding.label: Rounded corners
appearance.windows.rounding.description: 12 = the radius of the shell's panels.

appearance.windows.blurPasses.label: Blur passes
appearance.windows.blurPasses.description: More passes, smoother and more costly.

input.keyboard.layouts.label: Keyboard layouts
input.keyboard.layouts.description: The first one is the default; with more than one, the combination below switches them.

input.keyboard.repeatRate.label: Repeat rate
input.keyboard.repeatRate.description: Characters per second while holding a key.

values.2: Only the keyboard follows the mouse

input.mouse.followMouse.label: Window focus
input.mouse.followMouse.description: Follows the mouse: the window under the pointer gets the keyboard.

input.mouse.accel.label: Acceleration
input.mouse.accel.description: Flat: the pointer moves the same regardless of how fast you move (games, design).

input.touchpad.naturalScroll.label: Natural scrolling
input.touchpad.naturalScroll.description: The content follows your fingers, like on a phone.

input.touchpad.clickfinger.label: Two-finger right click
input.touchpad.clickfinger.description: Off: right click in the bottom-right corner.

display.outputs.label: Layout and mode
display.outputs.description: Each change is tried before it's saved: if you don't confirm within 15 s, the previous one comes back.

display.highRefreshOnAC.label: High refresh rate only when plugged in
display.highRefreshOnAC.description: On battery, the built-in screen drops to 60 Hz; when plugged in it goes back to the highest. A notice says so each time.

display.nightLight.enabled.label: Night light
display.nightLight.enabled.description: Warms the screen colors at night (hyprsunset).

display.nightLight.mode.label: When
display.nightLight.mode.description: “Sunset to sunrise” uses the weather city (Dashboard); without a city, the schedule.

when.reason: Only with the schedule (sunset to sunrise sets its own times).
Only with the schedule (sunset to sunrise sets its own times).
Only with “Warmer late at night” on.
Only with “Warmer late at night” on.
Only with “Warmer late at night” on.

power.suspendOnAC.label: Suspend when plugged in too
power.suspendOnAC.description: Off: it only suspends on battery.

power.inhibitWhileMedia.label: Stay awake while something plays
power.inhibitWhileMedia.description: With music or video playing, it doesn't dim, lock or turn the screen off.

bar.workspaces.scroll.label: Switch workspaces with the wheel
bar.workspaces.scroll.description: With the pointer over the bar's workspaces.

when.reason: Only with the bar on top or at the bottom (a side bar has no room for the title).

dashboard.tabs.label: Tabs
dashboard.tabs.description: The ones shown in the dashboard's tab bar, after Home. The others still open from their zone or their letter.

dashboard.openOn.label: On opening
dashboard.openOn.description: Which tab the dashboard opens on (the last one is remembered while the shell runs).

dashboard.home.zones.label: Home zones
dashboard.home.zones.description: What Home shows (the time and the music too), in what order and at what size. Edited in the dashboard itself (pencil or Ctrl+E).

context.label: Time and notices
context.description: The time, the date, the notices (only if there are any) and the weather.

media.label: Music
media.description: What's playing, on a card; the full player and the lyrics, in the Music tab.

system.label: System
system.description: Status, processor, memory, temperature and battery.

weather.label: Next hours
weather.description: The weather for the next hours. Needs a city (Weather).

profile.label: Profile
profile.description: Your avatar, a greeting and the computer.

quick.label: Quick access
quick.description: The apps and folders you pin (Settings → Dashboard).

notes.label: Notes
notes.description: A note that saves itself, only on this computer.

todo.label: Tasks
todo.description: A to-do list, only on this computer.

timer.label: Timer
timer.description: Pomodoro, stopwatch and countdown; notifies at the end of each phase.

now.label: Now
now.description: What matters most right now (rain nearby, a timer, tasks, the sunset); it appears only when there's something.

controlCenter.tiles.label: Quick settings
controlCenter.tiles.description: Which settings the control center shows, in what order and at what size. Edited in the control center itself (pencil).

dashboard.weather.location.label: Weather city
dashboard.weather.location.description: It's saved rounded (~10 km) and only on this computer; without a city, the weather queries nothing.

dashboard.profile.showSystem.label: Show the computer and the uptime

dashboard.quick.apps.label: Pinned apps
dashboard.quick.apps.description: The ones the Quick access zone opens, in this order.

dashboard.quick.folders.label: Pinned folders
dashboard.quick.folders.description: Empty: your personal folders (Downloads, Documents, Pictures…).

dashboard.timer.cycles.label: Focus rounds before the long break

dashboard.timer.autoContinue.label: Continue on to the next phase
dashboard.timer.autoContinue.description: Off: when a phase ends, the next one waits for you to start it.

dashboard.timer.sound.label: Sound when done
dashboard.timer.sound.description: Besides the notice. Needs pw-play (PipeWire) and the freedesktop sound theme.

dashboard.system.style.label: Style of the top four
dashboard.system.style.description: Gauges: the figure, a word and the bar or the history. Rings: the figure inside a ring and the temperature outside (no history).

dashboard.system.history.label: Short history in System
dashboard.system.history.description: Charts of the last minutes from what's already measured while you look at the dashboard; nothing is measured with the dashboard closed (so there can be gaps).

when.reason: Only with the short history on.

dashboard.system.charts.label: With a chart
dashboard.system.charts.description: Without a chart, the usual level bar.

when.reason: Only with the short history on.

dashboard.now.kinds.label: What the Now zone can show
dashboard.now.kinds.description: In this order of priority; it shows only the first that applies.

capture.copyToClipboard.label: Copy every capture to the clipboard

capture.freeze.label: Freeze the screen while choosing an area

media.preferredPlayer.label: Preferred player
media.preferredPlayer.description: If it's open, the bar, the dashboard and the media keys use it before the others.

media.ignoreBrowsers.label: Ignore browsers
media.ignoreBrowsers.description: Browser videos don't show up as a player.

media.lyrics.enabled.label: Look up lyrics online
media.lyrics.enabled.description: If there are no lyrics on your computer, it looks them up on lrclib.net (open, no account). It sends the song's title, artist and length; nothing else.

media.lyrics.dir.label: Lyrics folder
media.lyrics.dir.description: Files .lrc (“Artist - Title.lrc”, in subfolders too). Only read. A .lrc next to the song's file works too.

media.cover.shape.label: Cover shape
media.cover.shape.description: In the Music tab and on the Home card. The wavy ones turn a little with each song.

media.colors.fromCover.label: Cover colors
media.colors.fromCover.description: The progress bar, the play button and the audio bars take the cover's color, harmonized with your wallpaper. A grey cover or a color that could be mistaken for a warning uses the usual one.

media.visualizer.enabled.label: Audio bars around the cover
media.visualizer.enabled.description: In the Music tab, while something plays. Needs cava; it runs only while you see it (and not with “reduce motion”).

when.reason: Only with the audio bars on.

notifications.position.label: Where they appear
notifications.position.description: The control center opens there too.

notifications.sound.label: Sound when a notice arrives
notifications.sound.description: Silent with Do not disturb and with notices hidden in fullscreen.

notifications.system.capsLock.label: Caps Lock
notifications.system.capsLock.description: When turning it on and off.
